after.input: Search Verta documentation for fee refunds. Under what cause of transaction reversal is a fee refunded? Include the document's exact phrase beginning with 'because of'.

additional_metadata.reference:
A fee is refunded only when the underlying transaction is reversed because of a
Verta error.
additional_metadata.why_this_level: Умова повернення комісії, не тариф SEPA; перевіряємо причину reversal, а не суму комісії.

after.input: Search the Verta currency-conversion operations documentation. Which exchange rate is used to convert a reversed converted payment back? Use the document's exact phrase describing the rate and its timing.
after.expected_output: rate in force at reversal time

additional_metadata.reference:
If a converted payment is reversed, the reversal is converted back at the rate
in force at reversal time.
additional_metadata.why_this_level: Правило курсу при reversal, не відсоток комісії карткою; вузька перевірка часового прив’язування курсу.

after.input: Search the Verta dispute handling documentation. How long does a customer have to supply requested supporting evidence before the case is declined? State the number and the type of days used in the document.

additional_metadata.reference:
Failure to supply requested
evidence within 7 calendar days results in the case being declined.
additional_metadata.why_this_level: Строк подання evidence, не денний/місячний ліміт Tier 1; число і календарний тип днів.

after.input: Search the Verta onboarding documentation. When is a customer downgraded if they no longer meet the tier criteria? Use the document's exact phrase naming the review at which the downgrade happens.

additional_metadata.reference:
A customer who no longer meets the criteria is downgraded at the next annual
review, never mid-month.
additional_metadata.why_this_level: Момент downgrade тарифного рівня, не dispute window unauthorized_debit.
